msgs.t: Every company wants its own cover letter. One page each.
I'm applying to 6 places 😭 six letters??

slides.h: Name the role and the dates.
slides.b: "Attachment, January to April" in the first line, so they know exactly what you're asking for.
One line on what this company does that you want to learn. Change it for every letter.
"Cleaned the data for our class survey in Excel" beats "hardworking team player".
"Third-year BCom student." They plan placements around it.
Thank them, give your phone number, sign off. Attach the CV, don't repeat it.

slides.h:
A letter for each company.
KES 5.
slides.b:
Tell Toso the company and the role. Get the cover letter in Word or PDF.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
